title: oxalis corniculata subsp. repens
intro: Oxalis corniculata subsp. repens, commonly known as Creeping Woodsorrel, is a perennial plant belonging to the family Oxalidaceae. It has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, offering various health benefits such as reducing inflammation and improving digestion, due to its ability to stimulate digestion and alleviate symptoms of irritable bowel syndrome. The therapeutic actions of Oxalis corniculata subsp. repens include diuretic, anti-inflammatory, and antiseptic properties, which contribute to its use in treating urinary tract issues and skin conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, anthocyanins, and oxalic acid, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
